question: Detect app-store delistings: assemble App Store and Google Play IDs for every DAF or giving-account app seen in repo sources, press and archived pages since 2021, then re-check each ID's listing page (allowed by robots.txt) quarterly; a removed listing is a candidate shutdown to confirm.

rationale: iTunes search and lookup endpoints are disallowed by robots.txt; discovery ran through web search, which only returns live listings
